essential.screenreadertext: The majority of adults will still cover their faces in shops and on public transport
categorySort: Self-isolating if I have coronavirus (COVID-19) symptoms
Wear a face covering in shops
Wear a face covering on public transport
Maintain social distancing around others who I do not live with
Opening windows when I have visitors
Keep the number of people I meet with to a minimum
Arrange to meet up with other people in outdoor settings where possible
sourceText: Office for National Statistics - Opinions and Lifestyle Survey
